services.title: Four ways we help your business

assistants.title: AI built for your business
assistants.body: AI we build just for your business, handling routine tasks in management, operations and marketing without hiring more staff.

strategy.title: AI training for business
strategy.body: Invite us to teach you and your staff to use AI for your business, such as writing promotions, preparing quotes and summarising reports. At your place or online.

content.title: Photos & videos with AI
content.body: Product photos, ad videos, creator-style review videos and even brand character animations. We make all of it with AI for your promotions.

training.title: Skills classes for the AI era
training.body: Learn to work better with AI while sharpening the skills AI can't replace, such as communication and strategy. For students through to working professionals.

useCase.title: Which parts of your business can AI help with?
useCase.intro: This is work that usually needs extra hires or takes up your staff's time. Pick a part of the business.
useCase.note: Don't see your work here? Tell us about it, for free.

uses.label: Post ideas
uses.text: Every week you get a list of post ideas from what's trending in your field.

uses.label: Post drafts
uses.text: Send one topic, and a draft post is prepared in your business's style, ready for your approval.

uses.label: Prospects
uses.text: Prospects who have asked before are noted down, and you're reminded when to get back to them.

uses.label: Past customers
uses.text: Promo news goes out to past customers, so they remember to shop again.

uses.label: Customer questions
uses.text: Questions about prices, stock and services are answered automatically, including at night.

uses.label: Orders
uses.text: Orders that come in by chat are recorded on their own, with no retyping.

uses.label: Bookings
uses.text: Customers pick a free slot through the chat and the booking is recorded automatically, without waiting for you to reply.

uses.label: Stock
uses.text: You're reminded before items run out, so there's still time to restock.

uses.label: Invoices
uses.text: Customers who haven't paid get a polite reminder, so you don't have to feel awkward chasing them yourself.

uses.label: Payment proof
uses.text: Transfer receipts from customers are checked, then the order is marked as paid.

uses.label: Expenses
uses.text: Just send a message like “bought gas, 25k” and the expense is recorded right away.

uses.label: Receipts & files
uses.text: Photos of receipts and documents sent by chat are filed neatly per customer.

uses.label: Daily recap
uses.text: Today's total sales and best sellers reach your phone every evening.

uses.label: Complaints
uses.text: Customer complaints from different chats are gathered in one place, so you know what people complain about most.

uses.label: New staff
uses.text: New staff ask how the shop works, and the AI answers from the rules you wrote.

uses.label: Weekly summary
uses.text: Every week you get a summary of the busiest days and the items that rarely sell.

faq.title: What business owners often ask
faq.help: Still have questions? Ask us directly.

items.q: If I use AI, do I have to let my staff go?
items.a: No need. What moves to AI is the routine work, not the people. We train your staff in strategic thinking, communication and marketing. The decision stays in your hands.

items.q: What if the AI gives a wrong answer?
items.a: The AI only answers from information you approve, such as your price list and opening hours. When the AI isn't sure, the chat is passed on to you or your staff. Before it goes live, the AI is tested with your customers' questions.

items.q: I'm not good with technology. Can I still use it?
items.a: Yes. You just tell us about the work. We set it up, test it and teach you to use the AI until you're comfortable, for free.

items.q: I don't have any staff yet. Can I start with AI right away?
items.a: Yes. AI takes over the routine tasks that are usually the reason to hire, so your business can grow without taking on a fixed salary first.

items.q: Do I have to change my number or app?
items.a: No. The number and apps your customers know stay the same, and we take care of verifying the number.

It depends on the work you want help with, because every business is different. After the free consultation you get a clear quote and can compare it with the cost of hiring one person. Payment is flexible too.
Data is only used to run your AI. Access is restricted, and the data stays yours.
Yes. We're based in Pekanbaru and happy to visit your business.

about.title: About Kreatekno
about.lead: We are a small team from Pekanbaru that sets up AI assistants, creates content with AI, and trains business owners and workers. We want businesses to grow without sacrificing the people in them.
about.facadeAlt: The Kreatekno office in a row of shophouses, with purple glass and the word KREATEKNO above the door

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Kreatekno was founded in 2025 in Pekanbaru as PT Kreatekno Kreatif Teknologi. Behind every system we build are people, not robots: a small team that enjoys connecting different apps into systems that run on their own.
story.p2: What we build varies, from AI assistants that answer customer chats, automatic sales recaps and invoices, and product photos and videos made with AI, to training for staff. The goal is always the same: lighter daily work for your business.
story.quoteBody: We often hear this when a client's system starts running. The answer isn't magic. We map the workflow with you, build it, and then test it with your own business data.
